Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/11] The questionnaire assessed psychological well-being, friendship, aspects of intergroup relations, and drug use. The present research focuses on items assessing psychological well-being and social identities.

sample_type.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/10] All students in grades 8–10 from all six schools were invited to participate in a questionnaire study.

ethnicity.evidence_source: [/page/6/Text/8] The largest minority group in the sample was ethnic Turks (about 18%), further ethnic groups included Pakistanis (10%), Vietnamese (9%), Indians (7%), or other ethnic groups from Asia (15%); further groups included Albanians (7%), Iraqis (9%, mainly Kurds), and adolescents with a Nordic background (5%) or from other countries in Europe (14%, mainly from the former Yugoslavia).
